Third-party components shipped with VtubRust (rigrs)
====================================================

ONNX Runtime (onnxruntime.dll)
  Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. MIT License, see onnxruntime-LICENSE.txt.
  https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime

OpenSeeFace face tracking models (*.onnx) and the tracking algorithm rigrs ports to Rust
  Copyright (c) 2019, Emiliana. BSD 2-Clause License, see OpenSeeFace-LICENSE.txt.
  https://github.com/emilianavt/OpenSeeFace

Not shipped: Live2D Cubism Core (Live2DCubismCore.dll), property of Live2D Inc.
  rigrs downloads it from the official Cubism SDK after you accept the
  Live2D Proprietary Software License, or uses the copy of a VTube Studio install.
